name: Single-Arm Seated Row (Plate Loaded)
nameDa: Enarms siddende roning i maskine med vægtskiver
grip: Neutral grip on vertical machine handle.
description: Perform a unilateral row on a chest-supported plate-loaded machine, pulling one lever arm backward while bracing with the opposite hand.
setup: Adjust the seat height so the chest pad supports your sternum and the neutral handle aligns with your lower chest.
Sit tall with your chest pressed firmly against the chest pad and feet flat on the foot braces.
Grasp the top stationary handle with your non-working hand for stability.
Reach forward with your working arm and take a neutral grip on the row lever handle with full arm extension.
instructions: Initiate the row by driving your working elbow backward past your torso toward your hip.
Squeeze the shoulder blade and lat firmly at the peak contraction while keeping your chest glued to the pad.
Avoid rotating or twisting your torso to complete the pull.
Lower the weight smoothly under control until your arm is fully extended and your lat is stretched.
Complete the set, then switch to the other side.
cues: Keep chest glued to the pad.
Drive elbow back to the hip.
commonMistakes: Twisting the torso away from the pad to heave the weight.
Lifting the chest off the pad.
Using momentum instead of controlled lat engagement.

logging.example: One 25 kg plate loaded on working lever: record 25 kg per side.
logging.note: Plate-loaded machines feature independent lever arms; record the plate mass loaded on that specific side.

variantNote: Unilateral chest-supported plate-loaded machine row with neutral handle grip and independent lever arms.
